answer: Locks are written down in ferrous, expire in zephyr, and mesa lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 142 aliases as a result needs 195 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4217 identities would post 1717 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
